clips.title: The story
paras: Dragonmaw orcs have laid siege to Dun Algaz, cutting easy passage between Ironforge’s lands and Menethil Harbor. The fortified pass and its tunnels link Loch Modan with the Wetlands.

Dun Algaz cuts through the jagged peaks between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. The pass predates the War of the Three Hammers. After the Wildhammer clan was driven from Ironforge, its people used this route to migrate north. Stone tunnels, bastions, and watchposts guard the way. Whoever holds Dun Algaz controls the only overland road from the dwarven heartlands to Menethil Harbor on the western sea.

During the Second War, the Old Horde retreated to Dun Algaz after its defeat at Dun Modr. The pass became its final southern bulwark against Sir Anduin Lothar’s forces. The Alliance reclaimed it for a time, but Dragonmaw orcs have overrun the stronghold again. Dwarven Mountaineers have fallen back to the upper tunnels, leaving the mountain corridor a deadly gauntlet for travelers.
